challenges.restrictions: Only allowed damage source is Weapons. You may only buy one kind of Weapon, but you may buy as many copies of it as you want.

challenges.name: Only Income
challenges.restrictions: No +% Bounty Gold allowed.

challenges.name: Only Bounty
challenges.restrictions: No +Gold per second allowed.

challenges.name: Healing
challenges.restrictions: All damage sources must heal, increase Max HP or increase HP Regen.

challenges.name: One of Each
challenges.restrictions: Only allowed damage source is Weapons and you may have a maximum of 1 of each Weapon.

challenges.name: Frost
challenges.restrictions: Only allowed damage source is Weapons that deal Frost damage.

challenges.name: Alphabet
challenges.restrictions: All Weapons and Upgrades that deal damage must have the first letter in their name belong to the same group of letters.

challenges.name: Fire
challenges.restrictions: Only allowed damage source is Weapons or Upgrades with Fire damage.

challenges.name: Wave
challenges.restrictions: Only allowed damage source is Weapons with the Attack Type Wave.

challenges.name: Poison, Hard
challenges.restrictions: Only allowed damage sources are: Weapons or Upgrades that deal Poison damage.

challenges.name: Frost, Hard
challenges.restrictions: Only allowed damage source is Weapons that deal Frost damage.

challenges.name: Fire, Hard
challenges.restrictions: Only allowed damage source is Weapons or Upgrades with Fire damage.

challenges.name: Magic Coins Only
challenges.restrictions: Only allowed Upgrade that grants gold is the Magic Coin.

challenges.name: Magic Treasure
challenges.restrictions: You must buy a Magic Treasure during the first round and keep that Magic Treasure without purchasing another one.

challenges.name: Area
challenges.restrictions: Only allowed damage source is Weapons with the Attack Type Area.

challenges.name: Glaive
challenges.restrictions: Only allowed damage source is Weapons with "Glaive" in the name.

challenges.name: Barebones
challenges.restrictions: You may not acquire a single Upgrade of any kind.

challenges.name: Scaling
challenges.restrictions: Damage sources must either grant permanent stats or gain +% Damage based on a permanent stat.

challenges.name: Mana Shield Unbroken
challenges.restrictions: You must buy an Upgrade granting Mana Shield during the first round and never allow your Mana Shield to reach 0.

challenges.name: Income-Capped Damage
challenges.restrictions: Never let your Damage score become greater than your Income score.

challenges.name: 7500 Score
challenges.goal: Gain a combined 7500 Score across all games
challenges.restrictions: None
